## Belevico Pods
Belevico Pods are sold in boxes of 10 pods. A box costs ₺189. We currently offer 14 blends, from the mild "Ege Sabahı" (intensity 4) to the strong "Gece Vardiyası" (intensity 12).

# Setting Up Your Machine
## First use
1. Remove all packaging and tape.
2. Rinse the water tank and fill it with fresh, cold water.
3. Plug in the machine and press the power button. The machine heats up in about 25 seconds.
4. Run a rinse cycle: without a pod, press the lungo button twice. Repeat 3 times and discard the water.

## Connecting to the Belevico Home app
The Belevico Home app is available for iOS and Android.

1. Create an account or sign in to the app.
2. Hold the power button for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue.
3. In the app, tap "Add machine" and select your Wi-Fi network.

Belevico machines only connect to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks. 5 GHz networks are not supported.

Registering your machine in the app within 30 days of delivery activates Belevico Care+ (one extra year of warranty).

# Cleaning and Descaling
## Daily cleaning
- Empty and rinse the drip tray and used pod container every day.
- Belevico Pods are compostable, so used pods can go into a home compost bin or organic waste.

## Cleaning the LatteCore milk system (Forte only)
LatteCore rinses itself automatically after each milk drink. Once a week, remove the milk carafe and wash all its parts in warm water. The carafe parts are dishwasher-safe on the top rack.

## Descaling
Descale your machine every 3 months, or earlier when the orange drop icon lights up. A blinking red light means descaling is overdue.

Use only Belevico DescalePro (₺159, enough for 2 descaling cycles). Never use vinegar or other descalers: they damage the seals and void your warranty.

records.question: How do I connect my Belevico machine to Wi-Fi?
records.expected_output: Hold the power button for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue; in the app tap "Add machine" and select your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network; Belevico machines do not support 5 GHz networks.
records.answer:
Here's how to connect your Belevico machine to Wi-Fi:

1. **Check your network:** Belevico machines only work with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. 5 GHz networks are not supported, so if your router broadcasts both, make sure you select the 2.4 GHz one.
2. **Install the app:** Get the Belevico Home app for iOS or Android.
3. **Create an account or sign in** in the app.
4. **Put the machine in pairing mode:** Hold the power button for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue.
5. **Add the machine:** In the app, tap "Add machine" and select your Wi-Fi network.

If the connection fails, check that the network is 2.4 GHz, then restart pairing by holding the power button for 5 seconds again.

Also, if you register the machine in the app within 30 days of delivery, you'll activate Belevico Care+, which adds one extra year of warranty.

If you have a Belevico Nomad, note that it has no Wi-Fi and doesn't connect to the app. You'd register it by entering its serial number manually in the app instead.

records.question: What should I do if the orange drop icon lights up on my machine?
records.expected_output: The orange drop icon means descaling is due soon; you should descale the machine using Belevico DescalePro every 3 months or when the icon lights up.
records.answer:
When the orange drop icon lights up, your machine is due for descaling soon. Here's how to do it:

1. **Empty** the drip tray and the used pod container.
2. **Mix** one sachet of Belevico DescalePro with 0.5 liters of water in the water tank.
3. **Start the program** by holding the espresso and lungo buttons together for 3 seconds. The light will blink orange.
4. **Wait** about 25 minutes. The descaling program runs automatically.
5. **Rinse** the tank, fill it with fresh water, and run 2 rinse cycles.

Only use Belevico DescalePro. Vinegar and other descalers can damage the seals and void your warranty. One DescalePro pack (₺159) covers 2 descaling cycles.

If the light starts blinking red, descaling is overdue, so do it as soon as possible. Otherwise, descale every 3 months.

Our mission is to make café-quality coffee at home with zero plastic waste. Every Belevico Pod is made from plant-based material and is certified home-compostable within 12 weeks.

## Where we operate
Belevico currently sells and delivers only within Turkey. Our main warehouse and repair center are in İzmir (Kemalpaşa). Our showroom is in İzmir Alsancak and is open Monday to Saturday, 10:00–19:00. The showroom is closed on Sundays.

# Belevico Machines and Pods
## Belevico Aria
Belevico Aria is our compact everyday machine.
- Water tank: 1.1 liters
- Pump pressure: 15 bar
- Drinks: espresso, lungo, americano
- No milk system
- Price: ₺7,490

## Belevico Forte
Belevico Forte is our premium machine with a built-in milk system called LatteCore.
- Water tank: 1.8 liters
- Pump pressure: 19 bar
- Drinks: espresso, lungo, americano, cappuccino, latte, flat white
- LatteCore milk system with automatic rinse
- Price: ₺12,990

## Belevico Nomad
Belevico Nomad is a portable machine for travel and camping.
- Charges over USB-C; one full charge makes about 6 espressos
- Water tank: 0.25 liters
- Drinks: espresso only
- Price: ₺3,290

# Belevico for Business
Belevico for Business is our program for offices, cafés and hotels.

## Who can join
Companies that order 10 or more machines, or subscribe to at least 3 Office plans, can join Belevico for Business. To apply, email business@belevico.example with your company name, tax number and the number of employees.

## Benefits
- A dedicated account manager
- 15% discount on machines
- Invoicing with payment terms of net 30 days
- Priority repair: business machines are repaired within 5 business days instead of 10
- Free on-site setup in İstanbul, Ankara and İzmir

## Office plan reminder
The Office plan is a Pod Club plan with 12 boxes (120 pods) per month for ₺1,790. Business customers can combine several Office plans under one invoice.

# Cleaning and Descaling
## Daily cleaning
- Empty and rinse the drip tray and used pod container every day.
- Belevico Pods are compostable, so used pods can go into a home compost bin or organic waste.

## Cleaning the LatteCore milk system (Forte only)
LatteCore rinses itself automatically after each milk drink. Once a week, remove the milk carafe and wash all its parts in warm water. The carafe parts are dishwasher-safe on the top rack.

## Descaling
Descale your machine every 3 months, or earlier when the orange drop icon lights up. A blinking red light means descaling is overdue.

Use only Belevico DescalePro (₺159, enough for 2 descaling cycles). Never use vinegar or other descalers: they damage the seals and void your warranty.

# Returns and Refunds
## Return window
You can return items within 21 days of delivery.

- Machines: must be returned in their original packaging with all accessories.
- Pods: only unopened boxes can be returned. Opened pod boxes cannot be returned unless the pods are defective.
- Pod Club subscription boxes cannot be returned. You can skip or pause future deliveries instead.

## How to start a return
Start a return from "My Orders" > "Return an item". You will receive a KuşKargo return code by email. Drop the parcel at any KuşKargo branch within 5 days of receiving the code.

## Return shipping costs
- Defective or wrong item: return shipping is free.
- Change of mind: ₺79 return shipping is deducted from your refund.

# Warranty
The warranty does not cover:
- Damage caused by limescale because the machine was not descaled
- Damage caused by using third-party pods
- Damage caused by descaling with vinegar or non-Belevico descaling products
- Drops, liquid spills on the electronics, and other accidental damage
- Normal wear of seals and the drip tray

## How warranty repair works
Contact support with your order number and a short video of the problem. If the issue is covered, we send you a free KuşKargo pickup code. Repairs take about 10 business days at our İzmir repair center.

Belevico Forte owners receive a free loaner machine during the repair. Loaner machines are not available for Aria or Nomad.

# Warranty
## Warranty periods
| Machine | Standard warranty |
|---------|-------------------|
| Belevico Aria | 2 years |
| Belevico Forte | 3 years |
| Belevico Nomad | 1 year |

The warranty starts on the delivery date.

## Belevico Care+
If you register your machine in the Belevico Home app within 30 days of delivery, you get Belevico Care+: one extra year of warranty, free of charge. Machines registered after 30 days do not qualify for Care+.

## What the warranty covers
The warranty covers manufacturing defects in parts and workmanship.

# Returns and Refunds
## Refunds
After the returned item arrives at our İzmir warehouse, we inspect it within 3 business days. Approved refunds are sent within 7 business days after inspection, to the original payment method. For orders paid by bank transfer, we need your IBAN to send the refund.

Your bank may need extra time to show the refund on your card statement.

## Exchanges
We do not offer direct exchanges. Please return the item and place a new order.
